indicators.name: New York State prison admissions by year, 2008 to present
indicators.description: Annual counts of admissions to New York State prisons, split into new court commitments and returned parole violators. Counts come from the NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision.
indicators.publisher: NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision

indicators.name: People under New York State prison custody on March 31, 2008 to present
indicators.description: Counts of incarcerated people under the custody of the NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision on March 31 of each year.
indicators.publisher: NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision

indicators.name: Adult arrests in New York State by year, 1970 to present
indicators.description: Annual counts of arrest events for adults in New York State, from the county rows published by the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services, with felony and misdemeanor totals.
indicators.publisher: NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services

indicators.name: People in New York City jails, daily from the first recorded day
indicators.description: Count of people in NYC Department of Correction custody on the day it was read, by gender and age band. Sealed cases are excluded by the agency.

indicators.name: New York Board of Parole first-interview decisions, 2008 to present
indicators.description: Approvals, denials and postponements at New York parole first interviews, by year and crime class, from NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision data.
indicators.publisher: NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision
